title: File:Wikipedian getting a lumbar puncture (2006).jpg
desc: A lumbar puncture being performed. The needle is in place and the CSF is being collected in a small tube. The operator is wearing gloves to prevent infection. A large area on the back has been washed with an iodine based disinfectant leaving the back a brown/yellow colour.

title: File:Fluoroscopy guided lumbar puncture.jpg
desc: Fluoroscopy guided lumbar puncture is only indicated after multiple failed attempts of conventional lumbar puncture procedure. The tip of the spinal needle is located within the spinal canal, between L3 and L4 vertebrae.
